knowledge:
- key_parameters: clear_cache=logical, controls whether to clear cached data when retrieving OSCA Chapter 12 SingleCellExperiment ;; rna_layer=character, specifies the layer in MuData containing RNA counts (e.g., "counts") ;; protein_layer=Python object, specifies the layer containing protein counts (e.g., reticulate::py_none()) ;; modalities=list, maps keys like rna_layer, protein_layer, and batch_key to their respective modalities in the MuData object ;; max_epochs=integer, maximum training epochs for TOTALVI ;; accelerator=character, hardware accelerator to use for training (e.g., "cpu", "gpu", "mps")
- alternatives: Standard Bioconductor CITE-seq workflows (e.g., OSCA Chapter 12) which use scater, scuttle, and walktrap clustering on ADT quantifications instead of deep generative models.
- when_to_use: When analyzing CITE-seq data (paired single-cell RNA-seq and surface protein/ADT) and wanting to leverage deep learning-based joint latent representation, denoising, and batch integration via TOTALVI within an R/Bioconductor environment.
- pitfalls: Exposes Python objects directly in the global environment, which may lead to API instability ;; Running model training or get_normalized_expression on a CPU can be extremely slow ;; Large data downloads (up to 191 MB) require setting options(timeout=3600) to prevent timeout errors on slow connections ;; The package is noted as deprecated in Bioconductor version 3.24.

workflows.name: citeseq_totalvi_training
workflows.intent: Preprocess CITE-seq data, set up a MuData object, and train a TOTALVI model to obtain joint latent representations and denoised expressions.
input: HDP.h5 (10x human discovery platform CITE-seq data containing RNA and protein modalities)
workflows.stages: 1. Acquire and cache CITE-seq data ;; 2. Load data into a MuData object ;; 3. Preprocess RNA modality (normalize, log-transform, select highly variable genes) ;; 4. Subset MuData to highly variable genes and convert matrices to dense format ;; 5. Set up MuData for TOTALVI ;; 6. Initialize and train the TOTALVI model ;; 7. Extract training history (ELBO)
workflows.code:
library (scviR)
HDP.h5 = cacheCiteseqHDPdata ()
mdata1 = muonR () $ read_10x_h5 (HDP.h5)
mdata1 $ mod[ "rna" ] $ var_names_make_unique ()
reticulate :: py_run_string ( 'r.mdata1.mod["rna"].layers["counts"] = r.mdata1.mod["rna"].X.copy()' )
scr = scanpyR ()
scr $ pp $ normalize_total (mdata1 $ mod[ "rna" ])
scr $ pp $ log1p (mdata1 $ mod[ "rna" ])
reticulate :: py_run_string ( 'r.mdata1.mod["rna_subset"] = r.mdata1.mod["rna"][:, r.mdata1.mod["rna"].var["highly_variable"]].copy()' )
mdata1 = MuDataR () $ MuData (mdata1 $ mod)
reticulate :: py_run_string ( 'r.mdata1["prot"].X = r.mdata1["prot"].X.toarray()' )
reticulate :: py_run_string ( 'r.mdata1["rna_subset"].X = r.mdata1["rna_subset"].X.toarray()' )
reticulate :: py_run_string ( 'r.mdata1.mod["rna_subset"].layers["counts"] = r.mdata1.mod["rna_subset"].layers["counts"].toarray()' )
mdata1 $ update ()
scviR () $ model $ TOTALVI $ setup_mudata ( mdata1, rna_layer= "counts" , protein_layer= reticulate :: py_none (), modalities= list ( "rna_layer" = "rna_subset" , "protein_layer" = "prot" , "batch_key" = "rna_subset" ), )
model = scviR () $ model $ TOTALVI (mdata1)
runtim = system.time (model $ train ( max_epochs= n_epochs, accelerator = acc))
val_elbo = unlist (model $ history $ elbo_validation)
tr_elbo = model $ history $ elbo_train $ elbo_trai

workflows.name: compare_totalvi_osca
workflows.intent: Compare standard Bioconductor CITE-seq analysis (OSCA Chapter 12) with TOTALVI outputs by assembling a SingleCellExperiment.
workflows.stages: 1. Load OSCA Chapter 12 SingleCellExperiment ;; 2. Load TOTALVI AnnData ;; 3. Extract latent space, UMAP, denoised RNA, and denoised protein from AnnData ;; 4. Filter out specific batches and align cell IDs ;; 5. Build a new SingleCellExperiment with TOTALVI denoised RNA and protein as an alternative experiment ;; 6. Compare clustering concordance between OSCA and TOTALVI
workflows.code:
library (SingleCellExperiment)
library (scater)
library (scviR)
ch12sce = getCh12Sce ( clear_cache= FALSE )
options ( timeout= 3600 )
fullvi = getTotalVI5k10kAdata ()
totvi_cellids = rownames (fullvi $ obs)
totvi_batch = fullvi $ obs $ batch
totvi_latent = fullvi $ obsm $ get ( "X_totalVI" )
totvi_umap = fullvi $ obsm $ get ( "X_umap" )
totvi_denoised_rna = fullvi $ layers $ get ( "denoised_rna" )
totvi_denoised_protein = fullvi $ obsm $ get ( "denoised_protein" )
totvi_leiden = fullvi $ obs $ leiden_totalVI
is5k = which (totvi_batch == "PBMC5k" )
totvi_cellids = totvi_cellids[ - is5k]
totvi_latent = totvi_latent[ - is5k,]
totvi_umap = totvi_umap[ - is5k,]
totvi_denoised_rna = totvi_denoised_rna[ - is5k,]
totvi_denoised_protein = totvi_denoised_protein[ - is5k,]
totvi_leiden = totvi_leiden[ - is5k]
rownames (totvi_latent) = totvi_cellids
rownames (totvi_umap) = totvi_cellids
rownames (totvi_denoised_rna) = totvi_cellids
rownames (totvi_denoised_protein) = totvi_cellids
names (totvi_leiden) = totvi_cellids
comm = intersect (totvi_cellids, ch12sce $ Barcode)
totvi_latent = totvi_latent[comm,]
totvi_umap = totvi_umap[comm,]
totvi_denoised_rna = totvi_denoised_rna[comm,]
totvi_denoised_protein = totvi_denoised_protein[comm,]
totvi_leiden = totvi_leiden[comm]
totsce = SingleCellExperiment ( SimpleList ( logcounts= t (totvi_denoised_rna)))
rowData (totsce) = S4Vectors :: DataFrame (fullvi $ var)
rownames (totsce) = rownames (fullvi $ var)
rowData (totsce) $ Symbol = rownames (totsce)
nn = SingleCellExperiment ( SimpleList ( logcounts= t (totvi_denoised_protein)))
reducedDims (nn) = list ( UMAP= totvi_umap)
altExp (totsce) = nn
altExpNames (totsce) = "denoised_protein"
totsce $ leiden = totvi_leiden
altExp (totsce) $ leiden = totvi_leiden
altExp (totsce) $ ch12.clusters = altExp (ch12sce[,comm]) $ label
tot.se.averaged <- sumCountsAcrossCells ( altExp (totsce), altExp (totsce) $ leiden, exprs_values= "logcounts" , average= TRUE )
rownames (tot.se.averaged) = gsub ( "_TotalSeqB" , "" , rownames (tot.se.averaged))
metadata (totsce) $ se.averaged = tot.se.averaged
colnames (ch12sce) = ch12sce $ Barcode
ch12sce_matched = ch12sce[, comm]
